title: Houthi Strike on Government Military Camp in Southern Yemen Kills at Least 20 Fighters
detail: Houthi forces struck a government military camp in southern Yemen, killing at least 20 fighters, according to a report carried by The Hindu. The exact location and casualty attribution were not specified in the feed; figures are unconfirmed by independent sources.

title: Houthi Attack on Al-Alam Camp Kills 53 Yemeni Soldiers, Wounds About 200
detail: A Houthi attack on the government military camp at Al-Alam killed 53 Yemeni soldiers and wounded about 200, the biggest single loss of life since the civil war reignited, raising the earlier toll of at least 20. Saudi Arabia reportedly cancelled a major summit in response.

title: Houthis Claim Six Operations in 48 Hours Against Saudi Airports, Aramco Site, Oil Field
detail: The Houthis claimed six operations in 48 hours striking Saudi airports, an Aramco site, an oil field and military facilities. The claims are Houthi-sourced and unverified.
